description: A React component named PaymentsClient that manages and displays payment data for a specific shop. It includes functionalities for listing, searching, filtering, paginating, creating, and deleting payments, as well as associating payments with invoices and customers. The component interacts with external APIs and UI components, handles form validation, and manages local state for user interactions.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a currency string, defaulting to USD.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string into a locale-formatted date string or returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: toDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string into a yyyy-mm-dd format suitable for date inputs.

methods.name: fromDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts a yyyy-mm-dd date string into an ISO string.

methods.name: statusVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string based on invoice status for UI styling.

methods.name: methodVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string based on payment method for UI styling.

methods.description: Main React component for managing payments within a specific shop context.
